d: Shoulder-length, wavy rust-red hair is styled with thick, choppy bangs and a single prominent cowlick at the crown. The eyes are a matching rust-red shade with a determined, wide-eyed expression on a face with the apparent age and maturity of a young teenager. A slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved collared shirt, a red necktie, a black sleeveless vest, and a short pleated black skirt. Signature details include a black fingerless glove on the right hand, a white wristband on the left, and a utility belt featuring small mechanical turret components.
